To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of Space Based Computing and Semantic Web technologies with advanced RF memory Tag can provide for the user innovative applications and novel user interfaces.

1) the use of RF memory tags as an interaction device for mobile phones is possible, but the current state of the art in RF tags is not suitable for this purpose; and 2) the use of Semantic Web principles in mobile devices and the use of RF tags in the context of mobile phones is possible and has potential to provide a novel user interface.
RF memory tags can be used in conjunction with a mobile device to provide a user interface that is more intuitive and less intrusive than traditional user interfaces.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the user interacts with their environment through mobile devices and advanced RF memory Tags.
the development and evaluation of a system that allows users to interact with their environment through the use of a mobile phone and a RF memory tag.
the development of a novel framework for the interaction of a mobile device with its environment through the use of advanced RF memory tags.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integration of advanced RF memory Tag and mobile devices with Semantic Web principles provides a powerful tool for the future of ubiquitous computing.
this thesis has shown that the combination of the Semantic Web and space based computing technologies is a powerful platform for the development of novel and innovative mobile applications.

the use of advanced RFID tags with mobile devices and the use of Semantic Web principles provides a platform for the creation and use of innovative applications that are of great benefit and value to users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a system for the interaction between a mobile device and an RFID memory tag that supports the storage and access of semantic information.
we have developed an application that enables the user to interact with the environment through the use of RF memory Tags and mobile devices.
we have successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using a mobile phone to read a memory Tag and to use this data to access a Semantic Web based database and retrieve information.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of these technologies provides a powerful platform for the development of new applications.

by combining technologies such as RF memory Tags with advanced mobile computing platforms such as those that support the Semantic Web we can provide a novel and innovative way for a user to interact with their environment.
we have demonstrated that a combination of technologies such as Semantic web, RF memory tags and mobile devices can be used to create novel user interfaces.
